reserves.name: Physical silver bars (LBMA Good Delivery, Asian vault custody)

reserveReview.rationale: Matrixdock's issuer dashboards observed on September 21, 2026 report 73,039.260 XAGm outstanding, 72,927.000 troy ounces of physical silver, 73 silver bars, and a current 0.998463014 troy-ounce entitlement per token after the disclosed custody fee. The dashboards identify physical silver as the full direct reserve asset. The current aggregate disclosure refreshes the composition; it does not replace the separate June 30, 2026 Bureau Veritas audit.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Matrixdock issuer dashboards reporting the complete XAGm supply, physical-silver reserve total, bar count, and per-token silver entitlement
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete direct reserve asset is physical silver. Matrixdock does not publish a current vault-by-vault allocation or named-custodian split.
